verdicts.evidence: Head .limitless.toml test gate is now `bun test --parallel=$(bun scripts/test-workers.ts)` (base: `bun test`), and package.json test script is the same. src/pipeline/gate-evidence.ts (unchanged by the diff) accepts only /^bun test(?: [\w./-]+)*$/ in gateTestCommand and covers() also rejects any '-' argument and requires command === "bun test" for whole-suite coverage. Ran in the head checkout: gateTestCommand("bun test --parallel=$(bun scripts/test-workers.ts)", scripts) -> null; gateTestCommand("bun run test", headScripts) -> null; gateTestCommand("bun test", {test:"bun test"}) -> "bun test". engine.ts:1160 stores testCommand: gateTestCommand(check.result.command, testScripts), so every candidate gate on this repo now records testCommand null and applyGateEvidence refuses with 'candidate gate checks do not cover every required verification step'.
verdicts.reason: The change to the repository's own gate command silently disables factory gate substitution for sandbox-blocked verification criteria on this repo (worked at base), leaving such criteria blocked; the implementer neither adapted gate-evidence nor flagged the conflict.

verdicts.evidence: Ran `bun -e 'import {gateEnvDigest} from "./src/gates/cache.ts"; console.log(gateEnvDigest({LIMITLESS_TEST_WORKERS:"1"}) === gateEnvDigest({LIMITLESS_TEST_WORKERS:"8"}))'` -> true. gateEnv() at head now forwards LIMITLESS_TEST_WORKERS, but the baseline cache key ignores it; the gate command string itself is the literal `$(bun scripts/test-workers.ts)` so it does not vary either.
verdicts.reason: True that the worker override is not in the baseline key, but worker count does not change which tests pass on a correct base; the only effect is on load-sensitive flakes, which machine load (also not keyed) affects equally and which the retry/flaky path handles. Below medium.

verdicts.evidence: The diff contains no measurements (they belong in the PR description per the request's 'Measure (in the PR description)' section); the review case's input.implementerReport for review-108 is empty, and the commit that landed this work on main (febaff9b) states 'Measurements and the test-count check are added by the review', i.e. the submitted change did not supply the 4/6/8 comparison, serial-vs-parallel wall/user/sys, post-split top-10 or three clean parallel runs. Partial mitigation I checked: test titles at base (185 test( calls in test/pipeline.test.ts) vs head (187 across pipeline*.test.ts) show no test removed, only two added (panel-cleanup and redaction tests). (The one base-only title string, the ops-lens template literal, is present at head in test/pipeline-panel.test.ts:167, reformatted onto one line.)
verdicts.reason: An explicit acceptance requirement (pick the worker count by measurement and report it with three failure-free parallel runs) was not delivered by this change, so the default of 4 and the ~2-minute-per-file bound are unsupported; the code itself is otherwise reasonable.
